g.title: j1403870093
g.text: Ayatan Sculptures are ancient Orokin artifacts that are associated with the ritual of Orokin "Continuity."

g.title: j2141720277
g.text: Ayatan Sculptures are used to store the favorite memories of the Orokin...

g.title: j4112023452
g.text: Which we... won't get into now, because that's a whole different can of evil worms.

g.title: j4080024591
g.text: Continuity is the ritual that the Orokin would use to transfer their consciousness into another body.

g.title: j2082264928
g.text: They thought they were gods. Their favorite memories were often ones of torture, whippings, massacres... executions.

g.title: j1051410088
g.text: When you live forever, and you can just put your consciousness into another body whenever you want...
